title: Let Core ACP clients consume SSE frames live
goal: Add a bounded callback-backed AcpSocketClient stream API so ACP clients observe lifecycle and delta frames before a running mission completes, while preserving the collecting wrapper and plain HTTP limits.

results.boundary: Core ACP client transport only; no new dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, release, harvest, Windows, Jan artifact or credential change
results.coverage: AcpSocketClient now exposes prompt_stream_sse_with with bounded, callback-backed SSE parsing; prompt_stream_sse remains the collecting wrapper. Response implements Read without changing into_bytes limits.

acceptance.cargo run --offline --locked -p xtask --: passed; fmt 3.7s, clippy 13.7s, 145 of 145 test binaries, 0 failed, total 77.6s

results.limitations: The callback is bounded by MAX_HTTP_BODY_BYTES and stops on callback error; the existing collecting API remains available. Transport cancellation and session cancellation remain the existing ACP controls.
